basics.name: Sam Rivera
basics.label: Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Platform engineer. I run the billing and event systems at Northwind, where AI (Artificial Intelligence) and ML (Machine Learning) work sits next to a Postgres estate of 40 databases.

work.name: Northwind
work.summary: Own the billing and event platform. Promoted from Engineer in 2022.
highlights: Cut p99 read latency from 340ms to 45ms by moving the event log to Cassandra
Lead 12 engineers across Manchester and Kraków; retained 10 of them over 3 years
Hired and onboarded 14 engineers across 3 years, including the 2 who now run the platform
Took releases from every 6 weeks to weekly by introducing CI/CD across 9 services
Run the billing platform at 99.95% uptime on a budget of $1.4M and revenue of $20M

work.name: Acme
highlights: Shipped the Stripe migration for 40,000 customers in 5 months
